paper_metadata.title: High-Temperature Tensile Properties of a Cobalt-Based Co-20Cr-15W-10Ni Superalloy with a Bimodal Grain Structure

evidence.quote: Conventional cobalt-based superalloys with a unimodal grain structure generally exhibit low strength and ductility at high temperatures.
The present study investigated the high-temperature deformation behavior and mechanical properties of the Co–20Cr–15W–10Ni (CCWN) alloy that had a bimodal grain structure.
